policy.all_missing: All predictors or all targets masked; no sampling draw at 100 percent; seed identifies case only.
policy.class_coverage: At least two distinct determinate cases in each of READY, REMEDIATE, NOT_READY; otherwise inconclusive without replacements.
policy.critical: Unusable target, any declared numeric violation, or all predictor cells missing.
policy.domain_eligibility: Observed strictly positive integer cells in the eight declared numeric predictors; zero excluded because exact arithmetic negation cannot make zero negative.
policy.domain_operation: Exact arithmetic negation x -> -x; no inverse repair.
policy.missing_eligibility: Observed nonmissing predictor cells, including categorical and numeric values; native missing cells excluded.
policy.numeric_donors: All nonmissing nonnegative values in the same observed training column after approved masks; unapproved negatives never donors.
policy.protected: All targets, row IDs/order, column order, and every predictor outside approved coordinates; numerical dtype promotion changes representation only.
policy.repair: Mask supported negative numeric cells first; then fill only supported original missing cells and those newly masked cells with train-only nonnegative numeric median or categorical mode.
policy.rules_readiness: NOT_READY for unusable targets or all predictors missing; REMEDIATE for any predictor missingness or declared numeric violation; READY otherwise. No canonical scores consulted.
policy.sampling: Sorted row IDs, task column order, row-major eligible coordinates; numpy default_rng(seed).choice without replacement, sorted selected offsets; floor(rate * eligible_count).
policy.scalar: Existing task_suitability is categorical; correlation not estimable; no substitute scalar or manufactured probability vector.
policy.serialization: UTF-8 LF CSV with row_id; empty alone denotes missing; observation numerics nullable Int64; repaired numerics nullable Float64; literal None category retained.
